name: Qualys
description: Let agents read your Qualys vulnerability data: hosts and when they were last scanned, the vulnerabilities found on them, and what each vulnerability is and how to fix it. For endpoint compliance checks and remediation tickets.
identity: A Qualys user with the Reader role and API access. Qualys answers in XML, which agents read as text.

setup.title: Create a Reader user for agents
setup.body: You need a Qualys Manager. Give agents their own user with the Reader role, the least a user with API access can have, and only the asset groups agents should see.

link.label: Qualys: user roles and API access

click: In Qualys, go to Users, then Users, and select New, then User.
Enter the user's name, email and other details.
Under User Role, choose Reader and allow API access.
Under Asset Groups, add the asset groups agents should see.
Save, then sign in once as the new user to set its password.

setup.title: Find your API address
setup.body: Qualys runs on several platforms, each with its own API address, such as qualysapi.qualys.com (US1) or qualysapi.qualys.eu (EU1). You can test the user with the command below: it lists one host and changes nothing.
click: Find your platform from the identifier in your Qualys username, as Qualys' platform identification page explains.
Copy that platform's API server address from the same page.

fields.label: API address
fields.help: Your platform's API server, without https://, such as qualysapi.qualys.com.

capabilities.label: Read hosts and vulnerabilities
capabilities.description: List hosts with their operating system and last scan, list the vulnerabilities detected on hosts by severity and status, and look up vulnerabilities in the Qualys KnowledgeBase by QID.
capabilities.note: Reaches every host in the Reader's asset groups unless you keep an agent to chosen asset groups. Read-only.

limits.label: Asset groups
limits.help: Optional: only hosts in these Qualys asset groups, by their numeric id (in Qualys under Assets, then Asset Groups). Leave empty for every host the user can see.

revoke: In Qualys, go to Users, then Users, and deactivate or delete the agents' user. Agents lose access to Qualys at once.

tools.name: qualys_list_hosts
tools.description: List hosts, as XML: id, IP, DNS name, operating system and when each was last scanned. Up to 100 a time by default; when there are more, the answer ends with a warning naming the next id_min to pass.

details.description: How much of each host: Basic, or All for every field; /AGs adds its asset groups

asset_groups.description: Only hosts in these asset group ids
asset_groups.name: ag_ids

ips.description: Only these IP addresses or ranges, comma-separated, such as 10.0.0.1,10.0.1.0-10.0.1.255

ids.description: Only these host ids or ranges, comma-separated, such as 190-400

os_pattern.description: Only hosts whose operating system matches this regular expression, such as ^Windows

no_vm_scan_since.description: Only hosts not scanned since this date, YYYY-MM-DD

id_min.description: Only hosts with this id or above, for the next batch

truncation_limit.description: How many hosts at most, 1 to 1000

tools.name: qualys_list_detections
tools.description: List the vulnerabilities detected on hosts, as XML: per host its id, IP and operating system, then each detection's QID, severity, status (New, Active, Re-Opened, Fixed) and first and last found dates. Up to 50 hosts a time by default; when there are more, the answer ends with a warning naming the next id_min to pass. Look up what a QID is with qualys_get_vulnerabilities.

asset_groups.description: Only hosts in these asset group ids
asset_groups.name: ag_ids

ips.description: Only these IP addresses or ranges, comma-separated

ids.description: Only these host ids or ranges, comma-separated

qids.description: Only these QIDs or ranges, comma-separated

severities.description: Only these severities, 1 to 5, comma-separated or a range, such as 4-5

status.description: Only detections in these states, comma-separated: New, Active, Re-Opened, Fixed

include_vuln_type.description: Only confirmed or only potential vulnerabilities

show_results.description: 1 to include what the scan found for each detection, 0 to leave it out

id_min.description: Only hosts with this id or above, for the next batch

truncation_limit.description: How many hosts at most, 1 to 1000

tools.name: qualys_get_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Look up vulnerabilities in the Qualys KnowledgeBase by QID, as XML: title, severity, CVEs, whether a patch exists, and with details All the diagnosis, consequence and solution.

ids.description: The QIDs, comma-separated, or a range such as 1-200

details.description: Basic, or All to include diagnosis, consequence and solution
